summary_en: This phase 2 trial tests ziftomenib in adults with NPM1-mutated or KMT2A-rearranged acute myeloid leukemia (AML) who are not eligible for standard frontline therapy. Ziftomenib is taken by mouth once daily on days 1 to 28 of each 28-day cycle, for up to 24 cycles if the disease does not progress and side effects are acceptable. The record does not state the main outcome measure; it is a phase 2 study.
summary_es: Este ensayo de fase 2 evalúa ziftomenib en adultos con leucemia mieloide aguda (LMA) con mutación en NPM1 o reordenamiento de KMT2A que no son elegibles para la terapia estándar de primera línea. Ziftomenib se toma por vía oral una vez al día, en los días 1 a 28 de cada ciclo de 28 días, hasta 24 ciclos si la enfermedad no progresa y los efectos secundarios son aceptables. El registro no indica la medida de resultado principal; es un estudio de fase 2.
who_for: Newly diagnosed AML with a KMT2A rearrangement or NPM1 mutation, or other menin-sensitive mutations.
Not eligible for, or unwilling to receive, standard induction therapy.
Age 75 or older with adequate kidney and liver function, or age 18 to 74 with at least one listed comorbidity.
White blood cell count of 10,000/uL or lower; hydroxyurea, cytarabine, or leukapheresis may be used to control it.
Agrees to use effective contraception during the study.
not_for: Acute promyelocytic leukemia or chronic myelogenous leukemia in blast crisis.
Clinically active leukemia in the central nervous system.
Prior AML treatment, except hydroxyurea or cytarabine used to control white cell count.
Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors or inducers, with some exceptions; uncontrolled infection; QTcF over 480 ms.
Pregnant or breastfeeding; required dual antiplatelet therapy; condition that prevents informed consent.
